pieces.Text: A gingerbread witch learns a unique hex that lets her create a piece of candy or a similar sweet as a full-round action. If eaten by the witch or a single creature she designates when she creates it, the sweet functions as goodberry or a polypurpose panacea (UM) (as determined at creation). Anyone else that eats the sweet becomes nauseated (Fortitude negates); a creature nauseated by the sweet can attempt a new saving throw each round at the end of its turn to end this effect. A creature that fails its initial save is also affected as per the scar (UM) hex for
days, except that at extended range, the witch can use only harmful hexes on the creature. She can create
sweets each day. These sweets retain their potency for 24 hours and then turn to crumbs.
